comment: Record which source iModel each target ElementAspect was imported from, so transforms from different sources into a shared element no longer delete or overwrite each other's aspects. IModelImporter.importElementUniqueAspect and importElementMultiAspects take beta options objects: a filter for target aspects the import must leave alone, and known target aspect IDs for multi-aspects. importElementMultiAspects no longer takes a filter function as its second argument, and importElementUniqueAspect returns undefined when its filter skips the import.
